recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見多個核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁的芽細胞，中央一個小型、核不分葉的巨核細胞，旁邊散見少數分葉嗜中性球與含鐵血黃素，符合 AML 背景下的骨髓切片。
features: Increased immature cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Small megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated nucleus
Scattered segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors
Hemosiderin-laden macrophages and adjacent fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows increased immature cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with scattered segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors. A small megakaryocyte with a single round non-lobated nucleus is present, and hemosiderin-laden macrophages are noted. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; blast enumeration by CD34 immunostaining and molecular testing for CEBPA mutation are required, and isolated hypolobated megakaryocytes should prompt evaluation for multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Requires multilineage dysplasia in ≥50% of cells of ≥2 lineages or MR-defining genetics; a single hypolobated megakaryocyte is insufficient.
MDS-EB has <20% blasts with more preserved dysplastic hematopoiesis; aspirate and CD34 quantitation distinguish.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and are CD138-positive.
